hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Mandrel and guide
function: The composite tube that every other plug part is stacked on, with the guide at the bottom that leads the plug through the casing.

tabs.overview: Holds the ball seat at the top and the shear connection to the setting tool; the tension rod pulls the mandrel up while the sleeve pushes the slips and element down, so the parts compress against each other. Composite so the mill cuts it fast.
tabs.engineering: Composite, sized for the casing; bore for flow-through when the ball is not on seat.
tabs.safety: The stub left after milling must be small enough to wash down.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
